rule.title: Nothing sold inside an IRA or qualified retirement plan reaches Schedule D

when_missing.because: A brokerage form reports a taxable account unless a preparer says it is an IRA or qualified plan

citation.wording: The rules in this publication do not apply to investments held in individual retirement arrangements (IRAs), section 401(k) plans, and other qualified retirement plans.

rule.open_point: A broker files no Form 1099-B for a retirement account, so this answers a statement that reached the packet anyway; distributions from the account are Form 1099-R's.
